text:
Sam (AE): handing off NeonCare (closed today). commitment: Dedicated 4xGPU + Hosted fallback. primary asks: Okta SCIM + custom SAML attributes, 2yr audit retention, and VPC peering. kickoff target 6 weeks out.
Priya (CSM): cheers. pinging the CS onboarding checklist. Sam, drop the contract link and the pilot runbook pls.
Sam (AE): contract: https://redwood.example/contract/NEON-2026. Pilot notes: throughput ~110 rps, p95 latency around 220ms on small loadgen, they used streaming + rerank. cost matched estimate.
Sam (AE): flags: 1) legal needs 2yr audit retention guarantee. 2) Customer uses Okta with custom attributes (department, location) which must map into our SAML response. 3) wants a canary deployment in prod week 4.
Priya (CSM): Mei, can you confirm whether we can export full audit logs to customer S3 for the retention window? Also need SCIM provisioning test plan.
Mei (SRE): @Priya I can run a staging SCIM + SAML test. I need Okta metadata or an admin invite to their test tenant. Regarding logs, we can export to S3 but need to check encryption/KMS policies. May be a config-only workstream.
Luis (Support): I'll open support tickets for SSO validation and audit export. tag eng-platform if infra changes required.
Priya (CSM): owners: Priya - onboarding owner + acceptance criteria doc; Mei - SSO/SCIM validation & retention export options (3 business days); Luis - open tickets and triage; Sam - provide customer engineer contacts and confirm timeline.
Sam (AE): I'll send customer contacts and expected go-live windows by EOD. Note: they expect private peering but said optional. can escalate if needed.
Mei (SRE): Plan: 1) request Okta metadata 2) run attribute mapping against staging dedicated tenant 3) perform SCIM provisioning dry-run 4) validate log export to S3 with lifecycle rules. ETA 48-72h, may push 5 business days if schema touches required.
Luis (Support): Tickets created: SUP-9001 "NeonCare: SSO/SCIM validation" and SUP-9002 "NeonCare: Audit export/retention". linked to eng-platform oncall. added initial repro steps and pilot logs.
Priya (CSM): tagging renewal risk: legal retention ask -> Renewal_Risk=medium. capture in account health doc.
Sam (AE): customer acceptance criteria (initial): ingest 100k tokens/day, p95 gen <250ms, successful SSO SAML login with mapped attrs, SCIM provisioning of users, and archived logs accessible for 2yrs.
Mei (SRE): heads-up: if we need custom attribute mapping beyond standard SAML claims, that could require a small runtime change or config extension — possible 1 week latency.
Luis (Support): @Mei if eng-platform needed, include a minimal repro and config diff in SUP-9001. I'll escalate after your staging run.
Priya (CSM): feedback capture: customer asked for clearer cost per-routing policy breakdown. I'll add to product feedback board and follow up after onboarding baseline established.
ops-bot: calendar invite: "NeonCare onboarding kickoff" scheduled Thu 09:00 PT (Priya, Mei, Luis, Sam) :bell:
Priya (CSM): next steps recap: - Sam: send customer engineering contacts + confirm timeline - Mei: post SCIM/SAML findings here by 1795558200 - Luis: update tickets with results and next actions - Priya: prepare acceptance criteria doc and weekly cadence
Sam (AE): on it. thanks team.
Mei (SRE): I'll post the SCIM report here within 48h.
Luis (Support): will update SUP-9001 / SUP-9002 after tests and assign oncall if required.
Priya (CSM): closing note: logging the audit retention ask as compliance blocker until export & KMS are verified. will escalate to legal if we can't confirm a solution in 72h.
